name: Listing Title Length
description: Verifies that the listing title is between 10 and 60 characters in length.

name: Price Format Validity
description: Ensures the price field is a valid positive number and formatted with exactly two decimal places.

name: Required Category Presence
description: Checks that the listing includes a non-empty category field from the predefined list of valid categories.

name: Description Minimum Word Count
description: Validates that the description contains at least 50 words to ensure sufficient detail.

name: Image URL Accessibility
description: Confirms that all provided image URLs are valid HTTP/HTTPS links and return a 200 status code.
